summary: LED marquee with glowing text over a grid of unlit dots, coloured up and down arrows and soft edges; hovering eases it to a stop.
accessibility: The board is focusable with `role="marquee"` and `aria-label="Status ticker"`. The ticker items are text; the repeated copies that fill the loop are `aria-hidden`.
Click or tap also toggles the pause; while paused the label reads "Status ticker, paused".
motion: With reduced motion, the ticker does not scroll.
notes: The ticker items are built-in demo data (model, latency, errors, agents, uptime); there is no attribute for your own text.
Hover pausing applies to mouse pointers only. The board is 50px tall and scrolls with a CSS transform; the text is set in the monospace font.

data.note: The ticker items (model, latency, errors, agents, uptime) are invented; nothing can be set.
